mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM email_messages AS message JOIN case_email_threads AS thread ON thread.id = message.case_email_thread_id WHERE thread.case_id = #{caseId}

SELECT message.id AS message_id, thread.case_id, thread.gmail_thread_id, message.direction, message.sender_email, message.recipient_email, message.subject, message.body, COALESCE(message.received_at, message.created_at) AS sent_or_received_at FROM email_messages AS message JOIN case_email_threads AS thread ON thread.id = message.case_email_thread_id WHERE thread.case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY sent_or_received_at DESC, message.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
